properties.name: mcp.security.enabled
properties.description: Master toggle for MCP security auto-configuration.

properties.name: mcp.security.audience
properties.description: Expected OAuth 2.0 JWT audience (aud claim) identifying this MCP server cluster.

properties.name: mcp.security.hmac-secret
properties.description: Shared HMAC-SHA256 signing secret used to mint and verify MCP JWT access tokens.

properties.name: mcp.security.token-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Lifetime in seconds for minted MCP access tokens.

properties.name: mcp.security.clock-skew-seconds
properties.description: Allowed clock skew in seconds when validating token expiration and issued-at claims.

properties.name: mcp.security.replay-protection-enabled
properties.description: Enables jti (JWT ID) replay protection to prevent token or assertion replay attacks.

properties.name: mcp.security.require-capability-claim
properties.description: Requires incoming JWT assertions to contain a non-blank capability_id claim.

properties.name: mcp.security.default-token-budget
properties.description: Default per-window token budget assigned when the token omits a token_budget claim.

properties.name: mcp.security.default-qpm-limit
properties.description: Default per-minute query rate limit assigned when the token omits a qpm_limit claim.

properties.name: mcp.security.protected-path-patterns
properties.description: Ant-style URL path patterns secured by the MCP JWT authentication filter.

properties.name: mcp.security.clients
properties.description: Registered OAuth 2.0 clients authorized for RFC 7523 jwt-bearer client assertions.
